{{Top}} {{Character |type= |image=[[File:Mishko-FriendsEverywhere.jpg]] |name=Mishko |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}} |gender= |pronouns=She/her{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}} {{AD|Disney+}} |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Black]] |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Dark |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation= |masters= |apprentices= }} '''Mishko''' was the [[human]] assistant and art consultant to the wealthy [[Chandrilan]] oligarch [[Davo Sculdun]]. After she discovered that one of the pieces was a [[Forger (profession)|forgery]] Sculdun ordered her to have his entire collection re-appraised. ==Biography== {{Quote|It's a forgery. It's a good one, but-''"
"''It should be it certainty cost enough. I won't tell you what I paid for it. Unfortunately, the dealer I bought it from is dead. He's lucky he's dead.''"
"''Well, he may have been fooled as much as we were.|Mishko discussing the Coryio Chalice with Davo Sculdun|}} Mishko worked as an assistant to [[Davo Sculdun]], a wealthy [[Chandrilan]] [[gender|man]] that possessed an [[Davo Sculdun's gallery|art gallery]] in his office on [[Coruscant]]. In [[3 BBY]] Mishko discovered and informed Sculdun that the [[Coryio Chalice]] in his collection was a [[Forger (profession)|forgery]]. Despite Mishko's reassurance that even the best collections have occasional problems, Sculdun ordered that the entire collection be taken to be re-certified. Unbeknownst to either of them, [[Kleya Marki]], a [[Axis network|rebel member]], was listening to them with a [[listening device]] she had planted in a different artifact that Sculdun had purchased. Mishko later visited the [[Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest]], the shop where Marki worked and where Sculdun had bought the artifact with the listening device. While there Mishko confided in Marki about the issue with the forgery and that the entire collection was going to be examined following a party Sculdun was hosting during [[Senate Investiture]] [[Standard week|week]]. At the party Mishko talked again with Marki about the stress she's been under with regard to the collection's re-appraisals. {{Andor|What a Festive Evening}} ==Personality and traits== Mishko was a human with dark skin, brown [[eye]]s, black [[hair]]. ==Equipment== While informing Sculdun of the forgery, Mishko wore a blue-green [[clothing|robe]]. Later she wore a purple and maroon robe along with large gold colored [[Piercing|earrings]] when she visited the Galactic Antiquities gallery. During the investiture party Mishko wore a black and gold pattered dress with a large [[necklace]] and the gold same earrings. ==Behind the scenes== Mishko was portrayed by [[Mia Soteriou]] and appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the season's fifth episode, "[[I Have Friends Everywhere]]" which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 29]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}} {{1st|"[[What a Festive Evening]]"}} *{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=ミシュコ |ka=მიშკო }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]]
